arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ronald Van Amberg argued Congress enacted the equalization formula in 1994.
Justice Alito questioned whether the statutory language is truly unambiguous.
Justice Ginsburg noted the Department proposed the formula to Congress.
Justice Scalia asked if the same Secretary issued the new regulation.
